name: Ke Guihua
current_role: Chairman and President, Keboda Technology Co., Ltd. (SSE: 603786), Shanghai
profile: Wenzhou-born Ke Guihua chairs Shanghai-listed Keboda Technology (founded 2003, formerly Shanghai Oubao Electric), a supplier of automotive electronics - lighting control, body/chassis electronics, energy management and central computing/ADAS domain controllers - to Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi and VW. Keboda has expanded abroad with plants in Japan and the Czech Republic.
interesting_fact: Keboda says it co-develops products with 30+ global car brands, runs tech centres in Germany, France and the US, and in June 2025 bought 100% of Czech company IMI; it is a national 'specialised and sophisticated little giant'.
deep_cut_fact: In his signed chairman's message on Keboda's site, Ke opens with the proverb 'natural selection, survival of the fittest' and says Keboda holds to 'first principles' as its business essence while partnering with top AI ecosystem players.
notes: Low public profile; little personal biography online in English. xingzhengbu@ is the company's administration-dept address. Keboda site has an aggressive WAF (may block automated access). Vice chairman Ke Binghua is also on the board.

name: Zhu Yiwen
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, Hygeia Healthcare Holdings (HKEX: 6078)
profile: Zhu Yiwen, a neurosurgeon-turned-entrepreneur, founded Hygeia Healthcare in November 2009; it operates oncology-focused private hospitals and radiotherapy centres across China and listed in Hong Kong in 2020. He became chairman in 2021 and CEO, and he and concert parties have repeatedly added to their stake since listing.
interesting_fact: Hygeia's 2025 annual report says Zhu and parties acting in concert have never sold shares and have increased their holding 22 times since the IPO; he was named 'Wei Lan Award - Entrepreneur of the Year'.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Hygeia, Zhu directed the Gamma Knife Treatment Center at the Affiliated Hospital of Xuzhou Medical University (1998-2004), then ran the tumour radiotherapy centre of the PLA's 455th Hospital until 2015. In 2025 he became vice chairman of a China Medical Foundation clinical-specialty expert committee.
notes: Hygeia has an active IR function (won New Fortune best-IR listing) - IR email is the best route. Healthcare rather than energy angle.

name: Xu Shuqing
current_role: No current public role found; former chairwoman of Guangxi Wuzhou Zhongheng Group (SSE: 600252), resigned Jan 2016
profile: Xu Shuqing built Guangxi Wuzhou Zhongheng Group, a Shanghai-listed pharmaceutical and real-estate company best known for its Xueshuantong (notoginseng-based) injection, and appeared on Hurun China 2010-2015. She resigned all posts in January 2016 and the family holding company's 20.52% controlling stake was transferred to state-owned Guangxi Investment Group.
interesting_fact: Zhongheng's control passed to Guangxi Investment Group, which bought the 20.52% stake for about RMB3.88bn (RMB5.44/share) in 2016.
notes: NOT a suitable outreach target: per 2016 press she was detained in 2015 in a bribery probe before resigning, and no longer controls Zhongheng. Not on rich lists since 2015. No personal contact route found.

name: Wang Wenbo
current_role: Chairman, Heilongjiang Tianyouwei Electronics Co., Ltd. (Shanghai main board, listed April 2025)
profile: Wang Wenbo (b. 1970) co-founded Tianyouwei, a Suihua/Harbin-based maker of automotive instrument clusters and cockpit displays, with his wife Lv Dongfang (director and GM); together they hold ~86% directly. The company IPO'd on the Shanghai main board in April 2025 at RMB93.5/share.
interesting_fact: Tianyouwei is one of the few large listed tech manufacturers based in Heilongjiang; Wang was among the first recipients of the provincial 'Longjiang Science & Technology Talent' title and won a Heilongjiang provincial invention award.
deep_cut_fact: Wang started out in energy: from 1989 to 1994 he was a technician at the Shengli Oil Refinery of Shandong Qilu Petrochemical, then an engineer at Harbin Fenghua Machinery Plant, before running Harbin Tianyou Instrument Factory from 1997.
notes: Shares fortune with wife Lv Dongfang (a deputy to the 14th National People's Congress). Best route is the securities department (zqb@, contact per prospectus: Zhang Zhi). Country field blank in input; he is Chinese.

name: Chen Shuguang
current_role: Director and co-controlling shareholder, Zhejiang Cayi Vacuum Container Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 301004)
profile: Chen Shuguang and her husband, chairman Qi Xinghua, co-founded Zhejiang Cayi Vacuum Container (Jiayi) in Wuyi, Jinhua in May 2004. The company makes stainless-steel vacuum-insulated tumblers, bottles and food jars largely for export brands, and listed in Shenzhen in June 2021; the couple control ~72% of votes.
interesting_fact: US customs records list PMI WW Brands LLC (Pacific Market International, owner of the Stanley brand) among Cayi's buyers - linking the company to the global insulated-tumbler boom.
deep_cut_fact: Cayi began as Zhejiang Jiayi Vacuum Container Co., Ltd., registered on 12 May 2004 with capital put up jointly by Qi Xinghua and Chen Shuguang; it is headquartered in Baiyang Industrial Zone, Wuyi County.
notes: Fortune is shared with husband Qi Xinghua, who is chairman and the more public face. IR emails are those of board secretary Cai Rui and securities rep Zhu Dinghui as published in the 2026 interim report.

name: Liu Guocai
current_role: Chairman, CEO and Executive Director, Migao Group Holdings Ltd. (HKEX: 9879)
profile: Liu Guocai founded Migao, one of China's largest potash (potassium chloride, sulphate and nitrate) fertilizer producers, with plants across China and operations in Malaysia. He listed the group in Hong Kong in March 2024 at HK$4.08/share (one of the larger HK IPOs that quarter) and remains controlling shareholder.
interesting_fact: Migao says it ranks among China's top 10 fertilizer companies and is building a logistics and warehousing centre in Tongjiang, Heilongjiang on the Russian border, plus an R&D centre in Chengdu.
deep_cut_fact: This is Liu's second listing: his earlier vehicle Migao Corporation traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange (ticker MGO) as a China specialty-potash producer until a going-private deal he was affiliated with closed in September 2016.
notes: Low personal media profile. IR email is the best route; Hong Kong office at Cheung Kong Center II. Fertilizer/mining angle rather than energy.

name: Xiong Youhui
current_role: Chairman and President, Cubic Sensor and Instrument Co., Ltd. (Sifang Guangdian, SSE STAR: 688665), Wuhan
profile: Xiong Youhui (b. 1971), a PhD thermal-energy engineer, founded Wuhan Cubic Optoelectronics in 2003 and built it into a STAR-listed maker of gas sensors and analysers (CO2, particulate, methane, refrigerant-leak, automotive and medical oxygen sensors) plus ultrasonic gas meters. He controls ~50% and was re-elected chairman and named president in Aug 2025; his wife Dong Yu is a director.
interesting_fact: Cubic's product line reaches into energy infrastructure: thermal-runaway sensors for battery energy storage and EV packs, SF6 leak monitoring for grid switchgear, greenhouse-gas sensors and ultrasonic smart gas meters.
deep_cut_fact: Xiong holds a PhD in thermal energy engineering from Huazhong University of Science and Technology and a CEIBS EMBA, is a professor-level senior engineer, and receives the State Council special government allowance as an expert.
notes: Good fit for an energy/tech podcast (sensors for energy storage, grid, emissions). Fortune shared with wife Dong Yu. Board secretary is Chen Zihan (per Aug 2025 announcement).

name: Tu Yongjun
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Zhejiang Tianyu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 300702), Taizhou
profile: Tu Yongjun (usually written 屠勇军) founded what became Zhejiang Tianyu Pharmaceutical, a Taizhou-based maker of pharmaceutical intermediates, APIs and finished drugs, especially sartan blood-pressure APIs, plus asthma, diabetes, lipid and anticoagulant products. Tianyu listed in Shenzhen in 2017; he and his wife Lin Jie are the controlling shareholders.
interesting_fact: Tianyu had its peak year in 2020, when a global sartan API shortage drove prices up and it was one of the main suppliers able to fill the gap.
deep_cut_fact: Tianyu's origin is a small village-level outfit: Tu founded the Huangyan Chemical Factory in 1993 in Huangyan, Taizhou, and grew it into a listed API maker.
notes: Input lists name as 屠永军; filings use 屠勇军 - same person (Tianyu controller). Wife Lin Jie is the largest direct shareholder. Low media profile; IR email is the route.

name: Zhou Fugui
current_role: Chairman, Sany Heavy Equipment International (HKEX: 0631) since Nov 2025; director of Sany Group and Sany Renewable Energy (SSE STAR: 688349)
profile: Zhou Fugui is one of Sany's early core team, holding a stake in Sany Group alongside Liang Wengen and the other founders. He was a Sany Heavy Industry director/VP for 15 years, ran Sany America, chaired Sany Heavy Machinery (2009-16), then built Sany Renewable Energy, Sany's wind-turbine arm, chairing it 2020-Oct 2025 before moving to chair Sany Heavy Equipment International.
interesting_fact: He led Sany's push into wind power: executive director of Sany Renewable Energy from 2018, then chairman through its 2022 STAR Market IPO until October 2025.
deep_cut_fact: Before Sany existed, Zhou was an assistant engineer at Kunming Cable Factory (1983-85), then supply-section chief and deputy director of the Lianyuan special welding-materials factory (1988-91) - Sany's original business - and also served as general manager of Sany America.
notes: Excellent fit for an energy podcast (wind turbines). Listed on Sany Global's leadership page. Sany Renewable IR (sanyreir@) is the most relevant route; sanyir@ is Sany Heavy Industry IR.

name: Mark D. Millett
current_role: Co-founder, Chairman and CEO, Steel Dynamics, Inc. (NASDAQ: STLD)
profile: Metallurgist Mark Millett (University of Surrey, 1981) co-founded Steel Dynamics in 1993 and has been CEO since 2012 and chair since 2021, growing it into one of the largest US steelmakers and metals recyclers using electric-arc-furnace mills; it has since expanded into aluminum flat-rolled products. SDI's stock rose over 1,150% during his tenure as CEO.
interesting_fact: In 2025 he received the Bessemer Gold Medal from the Institute of Materials, Minerals & Mining and Harbor Aluminum's World's Aluminum Executive of the Year award; he was AIST Steelmaker of the Year in 2014 and 2022.
deep_cut_fact: Millett earned a metallurgy degree from the University of Surrey in 1981 and personally ran the design, construction and start-up of every SDI steel mill, starting with the original Butler, Indiana flat-roll melting and casting operation.
notes: Energy-intensive industry (EAF steel, aluminum) - relevant to power/decarbonisation themes. SDI press releases list Investor Relations at +1.260.969.3500 (company switchboard) but no IR email. Past chairman of the Steel Manufacturers Association.

name: Li Xiaoping
current_role: Chairman and Executive Director, Excellence Commercial Property & Facilities Management Group (HKEX: 6989); Vice Chairman and President, Excellence Real Estate Group, Shenzhen
profile: Li Xiaoping (b. c.1958) has been vice chairman and president of Shenzhen developer Excellence Real Estate Group since 1996 and has chaired its property-management arm since 1999. That business was spun off and listed in Hong Kong in 2020 as Excellence Commercial Property & Facilities Management, which he chairs; he and his wife Xiao Xingping are major shareholders.
interesting_fact: Li was named 'Most Innovative Person in China's Real Estate Industry' at the 2015 Boao Real Estate Forum, a 2018 'Top 30 CEO in China Real Estate', and Boao's 2009 'Social Contributor of the Year'.
deep_cut_fact: Li is a trained mathematician: a bachelor's in applied mathematics from the Chengdu Institute of Telecommunications Engineering (now UESTC, 1982) and a master's in applied maths from Xidian University (1988), before running Shenzhen Yonggao Industrial in 1993-96.
notes: IR email is printed as ir@exceam.com in the 2025 annual report (website domain is excepm.com) - verify before use. Hurun listing ended 2021 amid the property downturn; real estate rather than energy angle.

name: Zheng Xiaoyou (listed as Zheng Xiaoyong)
current_role: Co-founding shareholder of Tofflon Science & Technology Group (SZSE: 300171); board director until the Feb 2026 board re-election
profile: Zheng Xiaoyou (郑效友, b. c.1971) is the younger brother of Tofflon founder-chairman Zheng Xiaodong and a pre-IPO shareholder in Tofflon, the Shanghai maker of pharmaceutical freeze-dryers, aseptic filling lines and bioprocess equipment founded in 1993 and listed in Shenzhen in 2011. He served as a Tofflon director until his term ended on 3 Feb 2026 and chairs some affiliated companies.
interesting_fact: Tofflon, founded in December 1993, is a leading Chinese supplier of pharmaceutical freeze-drying (lyophilisation) systems and launched what it calls China's first dual-chamber freeze-dried formulation production line project.
notes: Input romanisation 'Zheng Xiaoyong' corresponds to 郑效友 (Zheng Xiaoyou). Brother Zheng Xiaodong is the public face/controller. Very low personal profile; no personal biography found. Only on Hurun 2011-2013.

name: Oleg Tinkov
current_role: Founder of Tinkoff Bank (now T-Bank); no current executive role - divested his stake in 2022
profile: Siberian-born Oleg Tinkov built and sold a string of consumer businesses (Petrosib electronics, Daria frozen foods, Tinkoff beer, sold to InBev in 2005) before founding branchless Tinkoff Bank in 2006, which listed in London in 2013. After publicly condemning the war in Ukraine he sold out in 2022, renounced Russian citizenship and is now a Cypriot citizen living abroad.
interesting_fact: Tinkov owned a UCI World Tour cycling team - Tinkoff-Saxo/Tinkoff, bought from Bjarne Riis in 2013 - and earlier ran the Tinkoff Restaurants and Tinkoff Credit Systems pro teams.
deep_cut_fact: Before business, Tinkov was a serious road cyclist from age 12 and earned the Soviet title 'Candidate for Master of Sports' in 1984; he started trading goods during cycling training camps in Central Asia, and later studied at the St Petersburg Mining Institute.
notes: Sensitive: UK-sanctioned (March 2022), designated a 'foreign agent' by Russia (2024), outspoken political critic; outreach could be politically delicate. Active on Instagram/X but handles not verified from an official source. No published office/press contact found.

name: Wang Jinhong
current_role: Co-founding shareholder of Glodon Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 002410); former director and chairman of the supervisory board (2020 to 2025)
profile: Wang Jinhong (b. 1963) is one of the founding shareholders of Glodon, the Beijing company whose cost-estimating, BIM and digital-construction software is used across China's building industry. He served as a Glodon director and later chaired its supervisory board from 2020; he remains one of its ten largest shareholders (about 71m shares).
interesting_fact: Glodon was founded on 13 Aug 1998 and listed on Shenzhen's SME board in May 2010; it grew into China's dominant construction cost-estimating software vendor and now sells BIM/digital-construction platforms (opened a UK subsidiary in 2025).
deep_cut_fact: Before Glodon, Wang worked as an engineer at the Beijing Nuclear Instrument Factory and then managed Beijing Yunxing Technology & Trade Co.
notes: Very low public profile; no longer an officer (supervisory board abolished Nov 2025; his shares are listed as 'locked after leaving office'). Only route found is Glodon IR. 'Dominant vendor' is a general characterisation.

name: Lin Weiguang
current_role: Chairman (since Dec 2025) and actual controller, Wedge Industrial Co., Ltd. (Wanze, SZSE: 000534), Shenzhen
profile: Lin Weiguang (b. 1963), a pharmacist by training with a Peking University EMBA, chaired Wanze Group 2006-2024 and controls Shenzhen-listed Wedge Industrial. Wedge makes probiotic live-bacteria drugs (Inner Mongolia Shuangqi's 'Jinshuangqi') and has built a superalloy business making turbine blades and powder-metallurgy discs for aero-engines and gas turbines; he became chairman in Dec 2025.
interesting_fact: Wedge's superalloy unit has trial-produced equiaxed, directionally solidified and single-crystal turbine blades from its own nickel-based master alloys, used in aero-engines and gas turbines - an unusual pivot for a pharma-rooted group.
deep_cut_fact: Lin started out as a pharmacist and was general manager of Shenzhen Wanze Pharmaceutical before building the group; he also chairs the Shenzhen Wanze Zhongnan Research Institute and is a director of Shenzhen Wanze Aviation Technology.
notes: 'Wedge' = Wanze (万泽). Gas-turbine/aero-engine superalloys give an energy angle. IR email (a 163.com address) is the one published in the 2025 annual report; board secretary is Cai Yongfeng.

name: Li Fuchen
current_role: Chairman, Fucheng Investment Group; actual controller and largest shareholder of Hebei Fortune Ng Fung Food Co., Ltd. (SSE: 600965, currently *ST)
profile: Li Fuchen built the Fucheng group in Sanhe, Hebei (near Beijing), and controls Shanghai-listed Fortune Ng Fung Food, which runs a 'food processing + funeral services' model: beef cattle farming, slaughter and beef products and catering, plus cemeteries including Sanhe Lingshan Baota Cemetery and Shaoshan Tiande Fudi Cemetery in Hunan. He holds ~73.8m shares directly.
interesting_fact: Fortune Ng Fung pairs farm-to-table beef with cemetery development - an unusual combination it calls a 'dual-wheel' model.
notes: Caution: company is under *ST delisting-risk warning, and the SSE publicly criticised the company and Li Fuchen as controller in Nov 2024 (per 2025 annual report). Not a good outreach fit. No personal biography found.

name: Yu Jianjun
current_role: Co-founder of Ximalaya (Shanghai audio platform), long-time chairman/CEO; Ximalaya became a wholly owned Tencent Music subsidiary in May 2026 - his post-deal title not confirmed
profile: Yu Jianjun co-founded Shanghai Ximalaya Technology in 2012 and built it into one of China's leading online audio platforms (podcasts, audiobooks, paid knowledge content). After several attempted IPOs, Ximalaya agreed in June 2025 to be acquired by Tencent Music for up to US$1.26bn cash plus TME shares; the deal closed on 18 May 2026.
interesting_fact: Tencent Music paid up to US$1.26bn in cash plus up to ~175m TME Class A shares (about 5.2% of TME) for Ximalaya, closing 18 May 2026.
notes: Podcast-industry figure - natural fit for a podcast host's outreach. Ximalaya's own site lists only a customer-service/report address (jubao@), not press. Post-acquisition, TME IR is the formal route; check his current title before outreach.
